column.text: Bitcoin is currently holding a pivotal inflection point near seventy-nine thousand six hundred ninety-four dollars as institutional ETF inflows of one-seven-four million dollars successfully offset significant retail distribution pressure and aggressive whale shorting activity on Hyperliquid desks. The evening session was characterized by institutional absorption of supply against retail distribution, evidenced by balanced exchange flows for Bitcoin and Ethereum despite significant whale net shorts reported in real-time books. Traders must treat failed rallies as better-odds shorts unless there is a high-conviction long with a real catalyst driving the move forward.
